design: Tall lean long-distance courier with a narrow swept forehead crest, four long slim mandibles, short dreadlocks gathered into a high single knot. A triangulated cross-chest travel harness, a flat hard-shell satchel with a broad beveled flap at the left hip, single padded shoulder guard and short split civic wrap. Right hand hooks the chest strap while the left holds a small unmarked sealed dispatch capsule. Ochre mottled hide, relaxed offset stance.
